title: Git HTTPS smart HTTP endpoint returns 403 "Bye" for all repositories
body:
### Comment

## Git HTTPS smart HTTP endpoint returns 403 "Bye" for all repositories

### Summary

Git operations over HTTPS are failing against Codeberg repositories with an HTTP 403 response containing only:

```
Bye
```

SSH Git access works correctly, and HTTPS access to normal Codeberg web pages works correctly. The failure appears isolated to the Git smart HTTP endpoint.

### Environment

Tested on:

* CachyOS Linux (host system)
* NixOS VM (fresh installation)

Software versions:

```
git version 2.54.0
curl version 8.21.0
```

Additional testing was performed using both IPv4 and IPv6 connections.

### Expected behavior

Running:

```
git ls-remote https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo.git
```

should return repository references.

### Actual behavior

The command fails with:

```
remote: Bye
fatal: unable to access 'https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
```

The same behavior occurs with my own repository:

```
https://codeberg.org/personanon5/nixos-config.git
```

and public repositories.

### Reproduction steps

1. Run:

```
git ls-remote https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo.git
```

2. Observe:

```
HTTP 403 Forbidden

Bye
```

### Diagnostic information

The following tests were performed:

#### GitHub HTTPS access works

Command:

```
git ls-remote https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs.git
```

Result:

Successful. Repository references were returned.

#### Codeberg HTTPS web access works

Command:

```
curl https://codeberg.org
```

Result:

Successful HTTP 200 response.

#### TLS verification succeeds

The TLS handshake completes successfully:

* Certificate is valid
* Certificate hostname matches
* OpenSSL verification succeeds

#### Multiple repositories tested

Failed:

```
https://codeberg.org/personanon5/nixos-config.git
https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo.git
https://codeberg.org/Codeberg/pages.git
```

This does not appear to be repository-specific.

#### Multiple Git protocol versions tested

All failed:

```
git -c protocol.version=0 ls-remote ...
git -c protocol.version=1 ls-remote ...
git -c protocol.version=2 ls-remote ...
```

### HTTP request details

The failing request is the Git smart HTTP discovery endpoint:

```
GET /forgejo/forgejo.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack
```

The response:

```
HTTP/2 403

content-type: text/plain

Bye
```

### Network testing

The issue was reproduced:

* On the original network
* On a different network using a VPN
* On the host system
* Inside a NixOS VM

This appears unlikely to be:

* ISP filtering
* VM networking
* local firewall
* DNS
* IPv6 configuration

### IPv4 / IPv6 testing

Both failed.

IPv6 successfully connected:

IPv4 also failed:

### SSH comparison

SSH access works correctly:

```
ssh://git@codeberg.org/personanon5/nixos-config.git
```

The issue appears specific to Git HTTPS smart HTTP access.

### Possible cause

The behavior suggests that the Codeberg web frontend is reachable, but the Git HTTP backend handling:

```
/.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack
```

requests is rejecting requests unexpectedly.

### Request

Could someone confirm whether there is an issue with the Git HTTPS smart HTTP service or whether additional diagnostic information is needed?

Thank you!
